theme: Trao đổi với kế toán thuế

vocab.example: We must submit the quarterly tax declaration before the 30th.
vocab.example_vi: Chúng ta phải nộp tờ khai thuế quý trước ngày 30.

vocab.example: We can only claim input VAT if we have a valid invoice.
vocab.example_vi: Chúng ta chỉ được khấu trừ thuế GTGT đầu vào nếu có hoá đơn hợp lệ.

vocab.meaning_vi: không được trừ khi tính thuế
vocab.example: Costs without proper invoices are non-deductible.
vocab.example_vi: Các chi phí không có hoá đơn hợp lệ thì không được trừ khi tính thuế.

vocab.example: The tax refund usually takes about six weeks.
vocab.example_vi: Việc hoàn thuế thường mất khoảng sáu tuần.

vocab.example: Please keep all contracts ready in case of a tax audit.
vocab.example_vi: Vui lòng chuẩn bị sẵn mọi hợp đồng phòng khi có kiểm tra thuế.

vocab.example: We overpaid tax last quarter, so we can use it this quarter.
vocab.example_vi: Quý trước chúng ta nộp thừa thuế, nên có thể bù trừ vào quý này.

vocab.example: This invoice belongs to the September tax period.
vocab.example_vi: Hoá đơn này thuộc kỳ tính thuế tháng Chín.

vocab.example: I will upload the file to the tax portal this afternoon.
vocab.example_vi: Chiều nay tôi sẽ tải tệp lên cổng thuế điện tử.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Chief Accountant)
lines.text: Hi Minh, thanks for coming. We need to finish the Q3 tax declaration this week.

lines.speaker: Minh (Tax Consultant)
lines.text: No problem. I checked your invoices yesterday. There is one issue with input VAT.

lines.speaker: Minh (Tax Consultant)
lines.text: Three invoices from a supplier have the wrong tax code. We can't claim that VAT yet.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Chief Accountant)
lines.text: I see. I'll ask the supplier to issue corrected invoices today.

lines.speaker: Minh (Tax Consultant)
lines.text: Good. Also, the team dinner last month has no invoice, so that cost is non-deductible.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Chief Accountant)
lines.text: Understood. What about the tax we overpaid in the second quarter?

lines.speaker: Minh (Tax Consultant)
lines.text: We can use it for this tax period instead of asking for a tax refund. It's faster.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Chief Accountant)
lines.text: Great. When can you upload everything to the tax portal?

lines.speaker: Minh (Tax Consultant)
lines.text: If I get the new invoices by Thursday, I'll submit on Friday morning.

questions.q: What is wrong with the supplier's invoices?
options: They have the wrong tax code

questions.q: Why is the team dinner cost non-deductible?
options: It was in the wrong month

questions.q: What will they do with the overpaid tax?
options: Use it for this tax period
